DIRECTION RULES
D01 [other, all scenes] Visual Style: Realistic Sri Lankan cinematic drama, natural lighting, authentic environments and emotionally grounded performances.
D02 [editing, all scenes] Scene Structure: Fewer, longer scenes with multiple camera shots and continuous dramatic action.
D03 [editing, scene 1] A romantic montage follows: Anudi visits Kasun after work. Kasun prepares her favourite tea. They spend time talking and laughing. Anudi helps him arrange food containers. Kasun walks with her to her car. They exchange smiles before saying goodbye.
D04 [editing, scene 1] A sequence of connected moments shows his struggle. He visits a bank and discusses a business loan. He sits with a potential investor and explains his business plan. He makes phone calls to friends asking for financial support. He reviews his business documents and calculations late at night. Each attempt ends in disappointment. The bank cannot offer the required support. The investor doesn't believe the small business can handle such a large order. His friends are unable to help.
D05 [sound, scene 3] Silence.
D06 [lighting, scene 5] The interior has warm lighting, wooden tables and Sri Lankan-inspired design.
D07 [lens, scene 5] The camera slowly pulls back, revealing the restaurant and its customers.
D08 [editing, scene 5] FINAL TEXT ON SCREEN: "සමහර ආදර කතාවලට සල්ලි ඕනේ නෑ. තමන්ගේ හීන විශ්වාස කරන කෙනෙක් හිටියම ඇති."
D09 [other, all scenes] Kasun maintains the same facial appearance, hairstyle and body type throughout.
D10 [other, all scenes] Anudi maintains the same facial appearance, hairstyle and body type throughout.
D11 [other, all scenes] Anudi's father maintains the same appearance throughout.
D12 [other, place L03] Kasun's three-wheeler remains the same vehicle.
D13 [other, place L03] His early food business remains small and humble.
D14 [other, all scenes] His clothing gradually becomes more polished as the business grows.
D15 [other, place L11] The final restaurant must visually feel like the successful evolution of his original business.
D16 [other, all scenes] Maintain authentic Colombo streets, vehicles, homes and environments.
D17 [action, all scenes] Keep performances natural and avoid exaggerated melodrama.

STORY
=== E01-S01 ===
13: SCENE 01 — KASUN'S EVERYDAY LIFE
14: Location: Colombo roadside – Food three-wheeler
15: Duration: 0.46 minutes
16: Early morning in Colombo.
17: The city is waking up. Buses, tuk-tuks, motorcycles and office workers fill the streets.
18: Kasun prepares his small three-wheeler food business. He arranges short eats, fills his tea
19: flask and cleans his small counter.
20: An office worker approaches and orders tea.
21: Kasun smiles and serves him.
22: After the customer leaves, Kasun looks at his small business. He notices the limited space
23: and old equipment but doesn't lose hope.
24: He looks toward the busy road and quietly speaks to himself.
25: Kasun: "දවසක මගේම රෙස්ටුරන්ට් එකක් පටන් ගන්නවා."
26: He smiles and continues working.

=== E01-S02 ===
27: SCENE 02 — ANUDI ARRIVES
28: Location: Colombo road – Family car and roadside
29: Duration: 0.38 minutes
30: A comfortable family car moves through Colombo traffic.
31: Anudi sits in the back seat, looking at her smartphone.
32: The driver stops near an office building.
33: Anudi gets out, carrying her handbag and umbrella.
34: She thanks the driver and walks toward the building.
35: Rain begins to fall.
36: She opens her umbrella and continues walking along the roadside, passing Kasun's small
37: food three-wheeler.

=== E01-S03 ===
38: SCENE 03 — THE UNEXPECTED ENCOUNTER
39: Location: Colombo roadside – Near Kasun's food three-wheeler
40: Duration: 0.29 minutes
41: Anudi walks past Kasun's three-wheeler while holding her umbrella.
42: She tries to put her smartphone into the side pocket of her handbag.
43: As she slips the phone into the bag, it accidentally slips from her hand and falls onto the
44: roadside.
45: Anudi doesn't notice and continues walking.
46: Kasun notices the phone lying on the ground.
47: He quickly picks it up and runs after her.
48: Kasun: "මිස්! මිස්! ඔයාගේ ෆෝන් එක!"
49: Anudi hears him and turns around.
50: Kasun approaches her, holding out the phone.

=== E01-S04 ===
51: SCENE 04 — A CONVERSATION THAT CHANGES EVERYTHING
52: Location: Colombo roadside – Near Kasun's food three-wheeler
53: Duration: 0.75 minutes
54: Anudi takes her phone from Kasun.
55: Anudi: "අනේ, Thank you! මම දැක්කෙවත් නෑ."
56: Kasun: "වැස්ස නිසා වෙන්න ඇති."
57: Anudi smiles and looks at his small food business.
58: Anudi: "මේ ඔයාගේ බිස්නස් එකද?"
59: Kasun: "ඔව්. පොඩියට පටන් ගත්තේ."
60: Anudi: "තනියමද මේ හැමදේම කරන්නේ?"
61: Kasun: "ඔව්. රුපියල් පන්දහසකින් පටන් ගත්තේ. තව ඉස්සරහට යන්න තමයි
62: බලාපොරොත්තුව."
63: Anudi looks impressed.
64: Before she can continue the conversation, her phone suddenly rings.
65: She checks the screen. It's her father.
66: Anudi: "හෙලෝ තාත්තේ."
67: Father (over the phone): "අනුදි, ඔයා කොහෙද ඉන්නේ? ඉක්මනට ගෙදර එන්න. අපිට
68: ඔයාගේ කසාදෙ ගැන කතා කරන්න තියෙනවා."
69: Anudi's smile slowly disappears.
70: Anudi: "හරි තාත්තේ. මම එන්නම්."
71: She ends the call.
72: Kasun notices her changed expression.
73: Anudi looks at him again.
74: Anudi: "එහෙනම් මම යන්නම්. ආයෙත් හම්බවෙමු."
75: Kasun: "හරි. පරිස්සමින් යන්න."
76: Anudi walks toward her destination.
77: Kasun watches her leave. After a moment, he returns to his small business, but his
78: thoughts are somewhere else.

=== E02-S01 ===
83: SCENE 01 — A FAMILIAR FACE
84: Location: Kasun's food three-wheeler – Different evenings
85: Duration: 0.54 minutes
86: A few weeks have passed.
87: Kasun is serving customers as usual.
88: Suddenly, a familiar voice interrupts him.
89: Anudi: "අදත් තේ එකක් ගන්න පුළුවන්ද?"
90: Kasun looks up and smiles.
91: Kasun: "අද නම් තේ එක විතරක් නෙවෙයි. Short eats තියෙනවා."
92: They laugh.
93: Anudi takes a seat beside the three-wheeler.
94: This becomes a regular routine.
95: A romantic montage follows:
96: Anudi visits Kasun after work.
97: Kasun prepares her favourite tea.
98: They spend time talking and laughing.
99: Anudi helps him arrange food containers.
100: Kasun walks with her to her car.
101: They exchange smiles before saying goodbye.
102: Over these repeated meetings, their friendship gradually develops into love.

=== E02-S02 ===
103: SCENE 02 — THE FATHER NOTICES
104: Location: Colombo roadside – Evening
105: Duration: 0.38 minutes
106: One evening, Anudi is talking and laughing with Kasun beside his three-wheeler.
107: Her father's car passes by.
108: He notices Anudi standing beside the small roadside business.
109: He asks the driver to slow down.
110: From inside the car, he observes them for a moment.
111: His expression changes when he sees the condition of Kasun's business.
112: He doesn't confront them immediately.
113: He continues driving, but his mind is troubled.

=== E02-S03 ===
114: SCENE 03 — THE CONFRONTATION
115: Location: Anudi's family home – Living room
116: Duration: 0.63 minutes
117: That night.
118: Anudi is sitting comfortably on the sofa, looking at her phone.
119: Her father enters the living room with a serious expression.
120: He sits opposite her.
121: Father: "අද මම ඔයාව දැක්කා අර කොල්ලා එක්ක."
122: Anudi looks up.
123: Anudi: "කවුද තාත්තේ?"
124: Father: "අර පාරේ කෑම විකුණන කොල්ලා. ඒ ළමයා කවුද?"
125: Anudi becomes slightly uncomfortable.
126: Anudi: "තාත්තේ, එයා කසුන්. මගේ යාළුවෙක්."
127: Father: "යාළුවෙක් විතරද? ඒ ළමයට මොනවද තියෙන්නේ? තමන්ගේ කියලා හරියට
128: තැනක්වත් නෑ."
129: Anudi looks disappointed.
130: Anudi: "එයාට හීනයක් තියෙනවා තාත්තේ."
131: Her father responds immediately.
132: Father: "හීනවලින් පවුල් ජීවත් කරන්න බෑ අනුදි. සල්ලි ඕනේ. අනාගතයක් තියෙන්න
133: ඕනේ."
134: Anudi looks at her father.
135: She wants to argue, but decides to remain silent.
136: She gets up and walks away.
137: Her father remains seated, convinced that he is protecting his daughter.

=== E02-S04 ===
138: SCENE 04 — KASUN'S DETERMINATION AND THE BIG OPPORTUNITY
139: Location: Kasun's small food preparation workspace
140: Duration: 1 minute
141: Late at night.
142: Kasun is working in his small rented workspace.
143: The room contains stainless-steel cooking equipment, food containers, business receipts and
144: a small table.
145: He checks his orders, calculates expenses and writes figures in a notebook.
146: His business has started growing. He is now supplying food to three small shops.
147: Anudi arrives and notices how tired he looks.
148: She looks around the workspace.
149: Anudi: "ඇයි ඔයා මේ තරම් මහන්සි වෙන්නේ?"
150: Kasun looks at her.
151: Kasun: "මට ඔයාගේ පවුලෙන් කවදාවත් ඔයාට මම ගැළපෙන්නේ නෑ කියලා අහන්න ඕනේ
152: නෑ."
153: Anudi gently holds his hand.
154: Anudi: "මට ඔයාගේ සල්ලි ඕනේ නෑ කසුන්. මට ඔයාවයි ඕනේ."
155: Kasun smiles.
156: Kasun: "ඒත් මට ඕනේ ඔයාට හොඳ අනාගතයක් දෙන්න."
157: Suddenly, Kasun's phone rings.
158: He checks the number and answers.
159: Kasun: "හෙලෝ, කසුන් කතා කරන්නේ."
160: A representative from a major supermarket chain is on the other end.
161: Representative (over the phone): "ඔයාලගේ food products අපේ branches කිහිපයකට
162: supply කරන්න අපි කැමතියි. ඒ ගැන කතා කරන්න පුළුවන්ද?"
163: Kasun is surprised.
164: Kasun: "ඇත්තටම සර්? ඒක ලොකු අවස්ථාවක්."
165: The call ends.
166: Anudi looks excited.
167: Anudi: "මොකද වුණේ?"
168: Kasun smiles.
169: Kasun: "අනුදි... අපිට ලොකු order එකක් ලැබෙන්න යන්නේ."
170: He looks at her with excitement.
171: But as he returns to his notebook and calculates the expansion costs, his expression slowly
172: changes.
173: The supermarket order requires a major investment.
174: He needs Rs. 2 million.
175: He looks at the numbers again.
176: He doesn't have enough money.
177: Anudi notices his silence.

=== E03-S01 ===
182: SCENE 01 — THE STRUGGLE
183: Location: Kasun's workspace and Colombo – Different locations
184: Duration: 0.54 minutes
185: Kasun is determined to secure the Rs. 2 million needed to expand his business.
186: A sequence of connected moments shows his struggle.
187: He visits a bank and discusses a business loan.
188: He sits with a potential investor and explains his business plan.
189: He makes phone calls to friends asking for financial support.
190: He reviews his business documents and calculations late at night.
191: Each attempt ends in disappointment.
192: The bank cannot offer the required support.
193: The investor doesn't believe the small business can handle such a large order.
194: His friends are unable to help.
195: Finally, Kasun returns to his small workspace.
196: He sits alone at the desk, looking at the supermarket order and the financial calculations.
197: He realizes that his biggest opportunity may disappear because he cannot find the money.

=== E03-S02 ===
198: SCENE 02 — ANUDI'S SUPPORT
199: Location: Anudi's family home – Bedroom
200: Duration: 0.38 minutes
201: Anudi sits alone in her bedroom.
202: She looks at a photograph of herself and Kasun.
203: Her phone rings.
204: It is Kasun.
205: Anudi: "කොහොමද කසුන්? වැඩේ හරියනවද?"
206: Kasun: "තාම හරියට විසඳුමක් නෑ අනුදි. බැංකුවෙන්වත් investor කෙනෙක්ගෙන්වත්
207: උදව්වක් ලැබුණේ නෑ."
208: Anudi sounds concerned.
209: Anudi: "හැමදේම හරියයි කසුන්. ඔයා උත්සාහය අතාරින්න එපා."
210: Kasun smiles slightly.
211: Kasun: "මම උත්සාහ කරනවා අනුදි."
212: They end the call.
213: Anudi looks worried but continues believing in him.

=== E03-S03 ===
214: SCENE 03 — AN UNEXPECTED OFFER
215: Location: Kasun's small workspace
216: Duration: 0.63 minutes
217: Kasun is reviewing business documents at his small desk.
218: Someone arrives.
219: It is Anudi's father.
220: Kasun stands up respectfully.
221: Kasun: "ආයුබෝවන් සර්. වාඩිවෙන්න."
222: The father sits down.
223: He looks around the small workspace.
224: He notices the business documents, food containers and calculations on the table.
225: He takes an envelope from his bag and places it on the table.
226: Kasun looks at it.
227: Father: "මේකේ රුපියල් මිලියන දෙකක් තියෙනවා."
228: Kasun looks surprised.
229: He opens the envelope and sees the cheque.
230: Kasun: "බොහොම ස්තූතියි සර්. මේක මට ලොකු උදව්වක්."
231: The father looks directly at him.
232: Father: "හැබැයි එක කොන්දේසියක් තියෙනවා."
233: Kasun looks up.
234: Father: "ඔයා මගේ දුවගෙන් ඈත් වෙන්න ඕනේ."
235: Silence.
236: Kasun's smile disappears.
237: He looks at the cheque and then at Anudi's father.

=== E03-S04 ===
238: SCENE 04 — THE CHOICE
239: Location: Same workspace
240: Duration: 0.54 minutes
241: Kasun remains silent for a moment.
242: He looks at the cheque.
243: He knows how much his business needs this money.
244: He looks at the business documents on the table.
245: Then he slowly pushes the cheque back toward Anudi's father.
246: Kasun: "සර්... මට ඕනේ අනුදිව මිසක් ඔයාගේ සල්ලි නෙවෙයි."
247: The father looks surprised.
248: Kasun takes a breath.
249: Kasun: "මගේ ව්‍යාපාරය මමම ගොඩනගා ගන්නම්. ඒත් මගේ ආදරේ සල්ලිවලට අතාරින්න
250: මට බෑ."
251: He stands up.
252: Kasun: "මට සමාවෙන්න සර්."
253: Kasun respectfully walks away.
254: The father remains seated.
255: He looks at the cheque and then around the small workspace.
256: For the first time, he begins to question his judgment about Kasun.

=== E03-S05 ===
257: SCENE 05 — A DREAM COMES TRUE
258: Location: KASUN'S Restaurant – Day
259: Duration: 0.83 minutes
260: Several months later.
261: A modern but welcoming Sri Lankan restaurant is ready to open.
262: The restaurant sign reads:
263: KASUN'S — SRI LANKAN FOOD & COFFEE
264: The restaurant is busy.
265: Staff members are serving customers.
266: The interior has warm lighting, wooden tables and Sri Lankan-inspired design.
267: Kasun, now dressed in smart-casual clothing, stands proudly near the entrance.
268: Anudi stands beside him.
269: She looks around the restaurant and smiles.
270: Anudi: "ඔයාගේ හීනේ ඇත්තටම හැබෑ වුණා කසුන්."
271: Kasun smiles.
272: Kasun: "ඔයා මාව විශ්වාස කළ නිසා."
273: Suddenly, Kasun notices someone approaching.
274: It is Anudi's father.
275: He slowly walks toward them.
276: He looks around the successful restaurant and then at Kasun.
277: Father: "මට සමාවෙන්න පුතා. මම එදා වැරදියට හිතුවේ."
278: Kasun listens respectfully.
279: Father: "ඔයාට සාර්ථක වෙන්න මගේ සල්ලි ඕනේ වුණේ නෑ. ඔයාට ඕනේ වුණේ ඔයා ගැන
280: විශ්වාස කරන කෙනෙක් විතරයි."
281: He extends his hand.
282: Kasun shakes it.
283: Anudi smiles emotionally.
284: The three of them stand together beneath the restaurant sign.
285: The camera slowly pulls back, revealing the restaurant and its customers.
286: FINAL TEXT ON SCREEN:
287: "සමහර ආදර කතාවලට සල්ලි ඕනේ නෑ. තමන්ගේ හීන විශ්වාස කරන කෙනෙක් හිටියම
288: ඇති."
